title: 2009 HMMT February Guts Problem 32
statement: Circle \(\Omega\) has radius 13. Circle \(\omega\) has radius 14 and its center \(P\) lies on the boundary of circle \(\Omega\). Points \(A\) and \(B\) lie on \(\Omega\) such that chord \(A B\) has length 24 and is tangent to \(\omega\) at point \(T\). Find \(A T \cdot B T\).
